## Core Specialties & Curriculum

### 1. 14-Week Offline Master Class (Flagship Course)
- **Duration**: 14 Weeks (12 Weeks Core Production + 2 Weeks Free Business & AI Growth)
- **Location**: Siwan Campus, Bihar (Includes 100% Free Hostel & Accommodation for outstation students)
- **Module 1 - Camera & Cinematography Fundamentals**: Sony Alpha/FX cinema cameras, Canon DSLR/mirrorless, lens selection (24-70mm, 50mm, 70-200mm, 85mm prime), shutter speed rule, ISO noise management, aperture depth of field, gimbal 3-axis stabilization (DJI RS3/RS4).
- **Module 2 - Studio & Wedding Lighting**: 3-point lighting setup, softboxes, diffusers, Godox continuous LED lights, RGB creative accent lighting, outdoor golden hour natural lighting manipulation.
- **Module 3 - Adobe Premiere Pro CC**: Workspace optimization, keyboard shortcuts, multi-camera sync (audio waveform sync), speed ramping, J/L cuts, keyframe animation, title creation, dynamic linking with After Effects, proxy workflows for 4K/6K footage.
- **Module 4 - DaVinci Resolve Studio**: Node tree structure, primary color wheels, log wheels, curve grading, custom LUT application, Color Space Transform (CST) from Sony S-Log3 and Canon C-Log to Rec.709, power windows, skin tone qualification, shot matching.
- **Module 5 - EDIUS Pro (Wedding Express Editing)**: Real-time multi-format editing, song project replacement, Indian traditional wedding rituals editing (Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, Jaimala, Bidai), fast client turnaround techniques.
- **Module 6 - Adobe Photoshop & Wedding Album Design**: High-end frequency separation skin retouching, dodge & burn, PSD album template designing (12x36 size), color grading photos, Karizma/Canvera print preparation.
- **Module 7 - Audio & Sound Design**: Dialogue cleanup, noise reduction, sound effects (SFX) layering, swooshes, risers, ambient room tone, royalty-free cinematic music licensing.
- **Module 8 - AI Tools in Videography (2026 Workflows)**: AI automated subtitle generation, voice isolation, AI script outlining, generative fill, AI-powered skin enhancement, studio CRM automation.
- **Module 9 - Business, Marketing & Client Acquisition**: Freelance pricing formulas, Instagram & YouTube portfolio showreel building, wedding client pitching, contract drafting, Google My Business local SEO for photography studios.

### 2. Specialized Short-Term Offline Courses
- **6-Week Video Editing Course**: Dedicated focus on Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and EDIUS Pro with hands-on timeline lab practice.
- **4-Week Wedding Album Design Course**: Adobe Photoshop mastery for modern 12x36 wedding photobooks, photo manipulation, and print lab coordination.
- **AI Wedding Filmmaking Course**: Pre-wedding storytelling, couple direction, gimbal movement techniques, drone composition, and AI-accelerated workflows.

### 3. Online Courses (Available in Hindi Across India)
- Accessible on web portal and Android app with offline video caching, practice project files, and certificate.
- Adobe Premiere Pro Course, DaVinci Resolve Masterclass, EDIUS Fast Wedding Course, Album Design Course, Pre-Wedding Shoot Course, Cinematic Wedding Editing, Digital Marketing for Photographers, Studio Automation & AI CRM.

## Student Demographics & Free Hostel Facility
- Quick Art Photography Academy serves students across North India, especially Bihar and Eastern Uttar Pradesh.
- **Bihar Cities**: Siwan, Gopalganj, Chapra (Saran), Patna, Muzaffarpur, Gaya, Darbhanga, Bhagalpur, Purnia, Motihari, Bettiah.
- **Uttar Pradesh Cities**: Ballia, Deoria, Gorakhpur, Mau, Azamgarh, Varanasi, Ghazipur.
- Outstation students receive free hostel stay with clean beds, high-speed Wi-Fi, and 24/7 electricity backup to practice in the studio lab day and night.
